# contentful_content_type (Data Source)

Reads a Contentful Content Type's current CMA model without activating or changing it. Alias routes require the response environment link to echo the requested alias ID; this Content Type behavior has not been verified live.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "contentful_content_type" "article" {
  space_id        = var.contentful_space_id
  environment_id  = var.contentful_environment_id
  content_type_id = var.contentful_content_type_id
}

# Use data.contentful_content_type.article.content_type_id in an Entry or
# Editor Interface configuration. The fields describe the current CMA model.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_type_id` (String) ID of the content type to retrieve.
- `environment_id` (String) ID of the environment or environment alias used to address the content type. A returned environment link that differs from this ID is rejected as unsupported response identity.
- `space_id` (String) ID of the Space used to address the content type.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Current CMA description; null when omitted, and empty when explicitly empty.
- `display_field` (String) Current CMA display field ID; null when explicitly null, and empty when explicitly empty. The curated decoder rejects an omitted displayField.
- `fields` (Attributes List) Current CMA fields in returned order, including unactivated draft changes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `id` (String) Composite Terraform lookup ID in `space_id/environment_id/content_type_id` form.
- `metadata` (Attributes) Current CMA annotations and taxonomy, or null when metadata is absent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `name` (String) Current CMA name of the content type.
- `published_version` (Number) Most recently activated Contentful version, or null when never activated. This does not prove the returned fields match the activated version.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_resources` (Attributes List) Allowed resources for a Resource Link field, or null when absent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--allowed_resources))
- `default_value` (String) Normalized JSON object of locale defaults, or null when absent.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the field is hidden in the entry editor, or null when absent.
- `id` (String) ID of the field within the content type.
- `items` (Attributes) Array item type and validations, or null for other fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields--items))
- `link_type` (String) Linked resource type for a Link field, or null when absent.
- `localized` (Boolean) Whether the field supports localized values, or null when absent.
- `name` (String) Name of the field.
- `omitted` (Boolean) Whether the field is omitted from Delivery and Preview responses, or null when absent.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether an Entry needs a value before publication, or null when absent.
- `type` (String) Contentful field type.
- `validations` (List of String) Ordered field validation rules as normalized JSON strings.
